text: Yes: CL10 now does it for every file the document viewer can open, not only pictures. Limits of the Artifact's store: standard web types only (images, PDF, video, plain text, Markdown, CSV, JSON); about 15 MB per file. A file over that, or of another type (a .docx, an APK), stays a link to the repo, and the post says so. CL10 will measure the exact limits and put them in the post guide.
